snippet.title: Nova Antarctica: Out Now Trailer
snippet.description:
Nova Antarctica – OUT NOW
Embark on a beautiful and lonely adventure in the ruins of Antarctica, 900 years in the future.
▼Steam Store Page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2054310/_/

＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝ 
"Welcome to Antarctica, the most mystical and harsh place on Earth."
Set in the desolate landscapes of Antarctica 900 years from now, follow a mysterious signal from the South Pole as the protagonist and their animal companions journey through a forgotten world.

Developed in collaboration with the Japanese game studio RexLabo.
A survival adventure blending vast map exploration with deep crafting elements.

Genre: Survival Adventure
Developer: RexLabo

■Special Website: 
https://en.games.parco.jp/page/novaantarctica/
